rules: Headlines MUST use Outfit with tracking-tight
Do NOT use Inter for main headings; Inter is reserved for body text and form labels
Use JetBrains Mono for badge indicators, manifesto chapter numbers (01, 02), and metrics

public_site: Header / Navbar (sticky compact with glassmorphism bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl, brand logo, nav links, WhatsApp quick action, Admin dashboard link, Get Started CTA)
Kinetic Hero Section (Masked line-by-line headline reveal, 3D Storefront ecosystem canvas with 2D fallback, hero conversion mini-form with instant lead capture, stats counter bar)

Differentiator Showcase ('Traditional Agency vs DR DUKAAN Growth System')
8-Step Scroll Journey Timeline (01 Discover → 02 Audit → 03 Strategy → 04 Digital Setup → 05 Traffic Launch → 06 Lead System → 07 Automation → 08 Scale & Grow)

3D/2D Growth Ecosystem Interactive Canvas / Visual Flowchart
SaaS Analytics Dashboard Showcase (Interactive mockup with real chart toggles, GA4 & Lead Source integration visuals, clearly labeled 'DEMO DATA')

Demo Case Studies Gallery (3 realistic Indian local success stories: Hyderabad Sweet House, Kurnool Hardware Mart, Jubilee Hills Dental Clinic with before/after revenue metrics & 'DEMO PROJECT' badges)
3-Tier Transparent Pricing (Starter / Growth Partner / Enterprise Dominance with Get Quote CTAs & feature breakdown)
High-Converting Multi-Field Lead Form (Name, Business Name, City/Location, Phone/WhatsApp, Industry, Current Digital Presence, Goals)
Contact Section (Hyderabad HQ & Kurnool Regional Office, Map embeds/visuals, Direct WhatsApp & Phone links)
FAQ Accordion (Addressing non-technical Indian shop owners' top questions: cost, time to go live, tech skills needed, maintenance, ROI)
Footer (Links, Legal, Local City SEO tags, Contact info, Copyright)
Floating WhatsApp Button (persistent bottom-right with pulse glow)
Editorial Slow Marquee (Subtle drifting keywords: Local SEO • WhatsApp Commerce • Google My Business • Hyper-Local Meta Ads • POS Integration • Instant Leads)
admin_dashboard: Admin Sidebar (Dark charcoal background, collapsible, navigation: Overview, Leads CRM, Clients, CMS Blog Manager, Services Manager, Settings, Public Site link)
Metrics Summary Cards (Total Leads, Active Clients, Monthly Revenue, Conversion Rate, WhatsApp Inquiries)
Leads Management Table (Status filters: New, Contacted, Proposal Sent, Converted, Closed; search, export, lead detail drawer/modal, status update dropdown)
Clients Portal Manager (Client name, city, service plan, MRR, renewal date, health score)
CMS / Blog Editor (Create/Edit post, category, SEO tags, publish status)
Analytics & Growth Reports (Interactive Recharts charts for Lead velocity, traffic sources, channel split)

motion_and_effects.3d_hero: Three.js / React Three Fiber scene with glowing central storefront geometry and orbiting cyan/violet floating nodes (Website, Google, WhatsApp, Ads, App, SEO, Analytics). Includes smooth auto-rotation and fallback 2D interactive canvas if WebGL fails.
motion_and_effects.framer_motion: Scroll triggered staggered reveals, hover lift on cards, line-by-line masked title reveal on hero load, glowing border pulses.
motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration on public marketing pages.
motion_and_effects.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon marquee using react-fast-marquee or CSS keyframes with low speed and subtle cyan text drift.

testing_and_attributes.rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, stunning, high-converting digital growth agency platform for 'DR DUKAAN' (drdukaan.com).
Implement both the full public marketing website and the admin SaaS dashboard seamlessly.
Ensure all interactive features work out-of-the-box (lead form submission, demo data toggles, industry selector tabs, pricing calculator/quote modals, contact forms, WhatsApp triggers).
Ensure zero placeholder URLs are used; all images must come from the media list above.
Follow the dark-first visual system with electric cyan (#00F0FF) accents, deep charcoal background (#090A0F), and violet secondary glows.
